note: Starting assumptions, not measurements. Calibrate compute_ms_per_layer_token and the network numbers against real devices before drawing performance conclusions. Memory is sized for the small test model's shard; `represents` records the real device class.

desktop-fibre.represents: Desktop or gaming PC with a GPU on a fibre line, always on

macbook-wifi.represents: Recent MacBook on home Wi-Fi; the lid closes now and then

old-laptop-wifi.represents: Older 8 GB laptop on a busy home Wi-Fi network

phone-4g.represents: Phone on 4G; backgrounded often (a worker only for small models)
